representation: Two composition lanes from one input: g then f on top, f then g below, with intermediate and final markers.
motion: The x slider moves all five markers; the two final markers separate whenever the orders differ.
misconceptionTest: f(g(x)) is substitution, not multiplication, and it need not equal g(f(x)).
accessibility: Alt text, keyboard-operable slider, textual formulas, circles versus squares distinguish lanes.
